description: Shared types used by the general Hivemind messages and by application payloads.

taskId.description: Opaque task identifier, chosen by the requester: at least 128 random bits, encoded as lowercase base32. Also the space key of the task's space. Must not be derived from the requester's identity, because agents see it in dispatches. The coordinator rejects a request whose task ID is already in use.

geoPoint.description: A WGS 84 position in degE7 (degrees x 10^7, about 1 cm). Integers because atproto records cannot hold floats.

uncertaintyMeters.description: Radius around the point that contains the true position. Set when a position was deliberately coarsened (dispatches) or measured with limited accuracy. Absent means exact.

geoPolygon.description: A simple polygon given as an ordered list of points. Implicitly closed: do not repeat the first point at the end.

money.description: An amount in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. cents for USD).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, upper case, e.g. USD.

attestation.description: A detached signature by the coordinator over the record that contains it. The signed bytes are the DAG-CBOR encoding of that record with the attestation field removed. Verify against the key named by keyId in the coordinator's DID document.

keyId.description: DID URL of the verification method, e.g. did:web:hivemind-network.com#hivemind_attestation.

signature.description: ES256 (P-256) signature in compact form, low-S, over the SHA-256 hash of the signed bytes.
